verdict.rationale: skills.sh CLI supports bulk-style operations: installing multiple skills with repeated --skill flags, using '*' to install all skills in a repo, targeting multiple agents at once (-a claude-code -a opencode), searching/finding across an entire org's repositories, and listing/updating/removing installed skills in one command. However these are batch operations on skills/repos, not a generalized bulk-operation framework across arbitrary 'many items', and there's no evidence of bulk operations at scale (e.g., hundreds of skills, parallelism, progress reporting) or independent hands-on confirmation of true bulk behavior beyond CLI flag docs. missing for 10: evidence of large-scale/parallel bulk execution, independent hands-on validation of multi-item operations beyond documented flags, and any bulk-editing/config across many installed skills simultaneously.
